**Recommendation (what the bots run).** Build (levels 10-60), 12/37/2 — no respec, one build from level 10 to 60. The decision loop walks 70 rules in ascending priority and executes the first whose condition is true. No party fixture places a member on this spec yet. [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/marksmanship/talents.yaml`, `rotation.yaml`]

## How the bots play it

On every decision tick the loop walks the rules in ascending `priority`, executes the first one whose condition is true and skips the rest of that tick. The groups below are a reading aid; the priority numbers are the real order. Level is the rule's own `level_min` — the first level it can fire.

### Single target

- **9 — pet attack** (`HM00d-pet-attack`) — level 10+ · intent `filler`
  - **When:** in combat; the pet exists; the pet is alive; the pet is not on the target; the target is hostile; (the tank has opened threat on the target or the target is attacking the resident or the lowest party health below 0%).
  - **Why:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target).
  - Sources: [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/marksmanship/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `core PetAI.cpp L465-L500`; `core Unit.cpp L9295-L9345`; `doc module/bots/src/Tick.cpp`; +1 more].
- **90 — Aimed Shot** (`HM09-aimed-shot`) — level 20+ · intent `filler` · spell 19434
  - **When:** the target is hostile; the target is at least 8 yd away; the target is within 35 yd; the resident is not moving; Aimed Shot is off cooldown; at least 50 mana.
  - **Why:** Marksmanship talent (417) taken at 20 and the DependsOn of Experimental Ammunition, which is in turn the DependsOn of Lock and Load.
  - Sources: [marksmanship.md § Single-target rotation (L121-122)](marksmanship.md#single-target-rotation); [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/hunter/marksmanship/rotation.yaml`; supporting: `DBC Talent.dbc:417`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L15214`; `sql tw_world_spell_template.sql L27378`; +3 more].

## Situational notes from the rule notes

Every sentence below is copied from a rule's own note (the rule id is in front of it) and mentions a situation the rule exists for. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here; their items are in the band table above.

- **HM00u-mongoose — Use Elixir of the Mongoose:** HO-TKB-PLAY-205 (PIONEER FIX, orchestrator for the owner full-kit order 2026-10-18: buff food, elixirs, oils and stones in use): Elixir of the Mongoose (item 13452, required level 46), elixir or potion (aura 17538 while it lasts), out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and the buff or enchant is missing (or under 5 min for an enchant), so it is also re-applied after a death or a swap. The spec's own guide page names it (line 233); the item and its aura or enchant id are read from the DB (docs/research/db-queries/tkbplay-205.result.txt).
- **HM00u-tel-abim-surprise — Use Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Danonzo's Tel'Abim Surprise (item 60976, required level 55), the ranged AP food (+45 RAP): "Firewater gives melee AP only; Danonzo's is the ranged AP food" (marksmanship.md L240); out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 57042 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HM00u-mageblood — Use Mageblood Potion:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Mageblood Potion (item 20007, required level 40), mana regeneration, the page's min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 24363 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HM00u-greater-arcane-elixir — Use Greater Arcane Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Greater Arcane Elixir (item 13454, required level 47), spell damage, a min-max pick (the page rates spell power low, marksmanship.md L102, but lists it L234); out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 17539 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HM00u-nature-power — Use Elixir of Greater Nature Power:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Elixir of Greater Nature Power (item 50237, required level 48), nature spell damage, a min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 45988 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HM00u-dreamshard — Use Dreamshard Elixir:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables, orchestrator ruling: every page-recommended consumable that is vendor-sold gets a rule so the kit carries it): Dreamshard Elixir (item 61224, required level 46), spell power and spell crit, a min-max pick; out of combat, not moving, not eating or drinking, only when the bags hold it and its aura 45427 is missing, so it is also re-applied after a death. Item, spell and aura read from the DB (tkbplay-342.result.txt).
- **HM00u-potion-of-quickness — Use Potion of Quickness:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Potion of Quickness (item 61181, required level 50, aura 45425: haste, 10 s, 2 min cooldown): "Potion of Quickness or Juju Flurry on pull or after Rapid Fire" (marksmanship.md L236). On a boss with the buff down, like the Juju Flurry rules (HO-253); Juju Flurry is not duplicated here.
- **HM00u-mana-oil-main — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Brilliant Mana Oil (item 20748, required level 45, enchant 25123: 12 mana per 5 s, 30 minutes) on the mainhand weapon: "Double Brilliant Mana Oil on two one-handers ... lets you skip Viper" (marksmanship.md L162; the Beast Mastery page takes the MM kit, L166).
- **HM00u-mana-oil-off — Apply Brilliant Mana Oil:** HO-TKB-PLAY-342 (hunter consumables): Brilliant Mana Oil (item 20748, required level 45, enchant 25123: 12 mana per 5 s, 30 minutes) on the offhand weapon: "Double Brilliant Mana Oil on two one-handers ... lets you skip Viper" (marksmanship.md L162; the Beast Mastery page takes the MM kit, L166).
- **HM00b-call-pet — Call Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6082 'Taming the Beast', kit.yaml), costs nothing (spell_template manaCost 0) and needs no target: effectImplicitTargetA1 32, targets 0, so the loop's own targetGuid (healTarget or hostile) is irrelevant, the same way a self-only buff resolves regardless of what RotationAction passes (Loop.cpp's own comment, next to Fade and Inner Fire). Priority 7, straight after HM00a-eat (6) and before every buff (HM02 at 20): THE PET WAS NEVER MISSING FROM THE DATABASE, ONLY FROM THE WORLD.
- **HM00c-revive-pet — Revive Pet:** Quest reward at 10 (quest 6081 'Training the Beast', kit.yaml, same acquisition tier as Call Pet), a 10 s cast (castingTimeIndex 7, SpellCastTimes.dbc CastTime 10000) and NOT free: manaCost 0 but manaCostPercentage 100, which Spell::CalculatePowerCost prices at 100 per cent of BASE mana for the caster's level (player_classlevelstats: hunter level 23 is 541) -- the whole bar, not a share of it. `mana_pct >= 100` was the first draft and was DISCARDED: it is only ever true at a single mana level, which is the same failure class HM01-hunters-mark and HM06-concussive-shot in this file already document -- a guard that is merely safe but rarely true just re-fires the refusal every tick, and decision 42 asks for a pet that WORKS, not one that is technically affordable and never revived.
- **HM00d-pet-attack — pet attack:** HO-TKB-PLAY-048 (orchestrator, p4-group 123; HO-P4-GROUP-123 read round 79): send the pet at the resident's target once the fight is on, and again on a target change (pet.attacking is true only when the pet's victim is MY target). A defensive player pet ignores its owner's attack while it is out of combat (PetAI::OwnerAttacked returns when the pet is not in combat and its owner is a player), so with no rule that sends it in it fought only what hit it or its owner: on the tank's target on 84 of 169 in-combat ticks in round 79.
- **HM02-trueshot-aura — Trueshot Aura:** Free, permanent, and its effects are SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_PARTY, so it is on the hunter as well as the party and aura_self can see it. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HM03-aspect-of-the-hawk — Aspect of the Hawk:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). With Bots.DrinkHoldsUnlessHurt 0 any cast stands a seated resident up, and in rounds 11-17 buffs, pet upkeep, dispels and non-emergency heals ended drinks and meals out of combat in every mana spec streamed (docs/research/tkb/play/r17-rest-breaks.txt).
- **HM03c-aspect-of-the-cheetah — Aspect of the Cheetah:** The pet-first pull and the 80 per cent shot hold of HO-TKB-PLAY-280 are NOT copied: "Only a BM pet tanks anything useful" (L116).
- **HM03b-aspect-of-the-monkey — Aspect of the Monkey:** Aspect of the Hawk (level 10, priority above this rule) replaces it: `not aura_self(13165)` keeps the two from flapping and the Hawk rule wins the tick whenever it can be cast. AMP-6 PATCH: the same two stand-down clauses as the Hawk rule above, on the same aura-first terms.
- **HM03a-aspect-of-the-viper — Aspect of the Viper:** At the pin it is a level-56 trainer aspect costing nothing to cast whose single effect is aura 21 (SPELL_AURA_OBS_MOD_MANA), a periodic mana return, and it replaces Aspect of the Hawk because a hunter holds one aspect at a time. HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435).
- **HM04a-feign-death — Feign Death:** At the pin Feign Death 5384 is a trainer spell at 30, 80 mana, 30 s recoveryTime, aura 66, and Aura::HandleFeignDeath fails the feign when a hostile creature in its own attack reach does not miss a spell-hit roll, so it is a drop from range, not in melee. HO-TKB-PLAY-174 (PIONEER FIX, observer Hateforge playbook section 1.5, p4-group 456 core-script read L296-L339, vocabulary v35 enemies_engaged_entry): never while Har'gesh Doomcaller (60737) has a Faceless Terror (60738) alive: a Terror with no victim calls the boss EnterEvadeMode every 5 s, which resets him to full health and despawns the Terrors, and an evade by a hunter or rogue leaves the Terror victimless.
- **HM05s-scare-beast-second — Scare Beast:** The guide, hunter/leveling.md L148: "On beasts, Scare Beast the second mob (1.5 s cast)"; the pet and the shots take the first. Alone only (in a party a feared mob runs into the group), the second attacker is a beast (`creature_type(1)`), 35 mana at level 14, 50 at rank 2 (level 30).
- **HM09-aimed-shot — Aimed Shot:** At the pin Lock and Load is the talent aura 52920 (procFlags 320, trigger 52921) whose proc calls Unit::RemoveSpellCooldown on every Aimed Shot rank (spell_hunter.cpp L563-L581), so the proc's whole observable effect is that cooldown_ready(19434) becomes true again, and this rule is the first shot in the ladder (priority 90) so it fires on it. A rule gated on aura_self(52921) would be redundant, and with the proc's own short duration less reliable than the cooldown it clears.
- **HM10-multi-shot — Multi-Shot:** A mob on the pet is not counted (risk noted in HUN-01).
- **HM07b-mongoose-bite — Mongoose Bite:** At the pin Mongoose Bite 1495 carries no caster aura state (no dodge needed, the Turtle change of 2024-10-12, survival synthesis L19) and a script (spell_hunter_mongoose_bite), 30 mana, 5 s cooldown.
- **HM10b-mend-pet — Mend Pet:** Trainer spell at 12 (kit.yaml, trainer_learn_spell 1117), 50 mana at the pin (spell_template manaCost 50) and, contrary to how it reads, NOT instant: attributesEx 4 is SPELL_ATTR_EX_CHANNELED_1 and durationIndex 28 is 5000 ms -- 'heals your pet X health every second while you focus, lasts 5s' -- the same shape as the warlock's Health Funnel (755), which decision 44 keeps strictly out of combat. CHECKED BEFORE SHIPPING IT IN COMBAT: channelInterruptFlags is 31756 (0x7C0C) at the pin, which decodes to CHANNEL_FLAG_INTERRUPT (0x0004), CHANNEL_FLAG_MOVEMENT (0x0008) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DELAY (0x4000) -- CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE (0x0002) and CHANNEL_FLAG_DAMAGE2 (0x0080) are both ABSENT, so taking a hit does not break this channel the way it would if the flag were set.
- **HM11e-arcane-shot-enchanted-ammo — Arcane Shot:** The mechanic at the pin: Experimental Ammunition (talent, level 30) cycles the hunter's active ammunition state Explosive (58109) -> Poisonous (58110) -> Enchanted (58111) on each Aimed Shot that lands (spell_hunter.cpp L477-L527, SPELL_HUNTER_ENCHANTED_AMMUNITION = 58111), so the state is an aura the vocabulary reads: `aura_self(58111)`.
- **HM10a-volley — Volley:** A mob on the pet is not counted (risk noted in HUN-01).
- **HM01-hunters-mark — Hunter's Mark:** The mechanism is that the rule's `when` is re-satisfied by its own failure -- the cast fails, so aura_target(1130) stays false, so the rule stays true -- and the vocabulary has no line-of-sight term to guard it with (OQ-2236). HO-TKB-PLAY-173 (PIONEER FIX, owner: no repeated Hunter's Mark): and the mark goes on a boss or on a lone enemy (`target.boss or enemies_engaged_within(40) <= 1`).

## What the bots do not do (from the rule notes)

Sentences from the rules' notes that say what is deliberately not implemented, or that name an open question.

- **HM00u-mana-oil-main:** Brilliant Wizard Oil (L234) is NOT built: it would take the same two slots and replace this oil (open question 1).
- **HM00u-mana-oil-off:** Brilliant Wizard Oil (L234) is NOT built: it would take the same two slots and replace this oil (open question 1).
- **HM03c-aspect-of-the-cheetah:** Same rule as HB02c-aspect-of-the-cheetah of HO-TKB-PLAY-280, which carries the reasoning (40 mana, `mana_pct >= 70` is our own floor, open question 2). leveling.md has no Marksmanship bracket text (it rates the spec B and gives it no table, L9-L11); the loop it calls bot-ready (L292-L301) is written for any hunter, with Hawk or Monkey as the pull aspect, and is applied here as an extension (open question 1 of HO-TKB-PLAY-281).
- **HM13-auto-shot:** The 2,923 autorepeat_active refusals (the push while it is already repeating) cannot be expressed here: no predicate says that Auto Shot is running, so that refusal is the runtime's (p3-runtime, p1-loop).
